content: Thank you so much for taking your time to answer this! I will definitely consider your points and wait for ghelot as you said.
What team composition would you suggest based on my current rooster?

With what you got so far I'd try Tulu-Saya-Aurita-Murphy

Unfortunately you won't be able to fully benefit from Saya but her 0-cost is insane as is.

- Tulu unleashes lots of tentacle attack to trigger the corrosion,

- Murphy does as well and boost tentacle damage.

- Aurita, again, triggers tent atracks but also benefits from the discard provided by Saya

- Saya cycles command cards ( *only command cards* > not symptoms, rouse or neutral cards like posse cards ) and applies lots of corrosion

Since you're a newcomer I wouldn't worry too much ablut your linup. The early chapters are lenient enough that you can fiddle with your team and pull through.

I suggest to take that opportunity to try as many awakeners and combinations as you can

Try building a team around Aurita, since she's a free unit nuke she gives tons of damage that takes out the heads if you set up her nuke right. You can get free copies of her enlightenments in the shop. She works really well with Corposant who gives the whole team tons of survivability. 

Aequor teams are really strong and are great for mainstory content, so do pull on them in the standard banner. Caecus and Celeste are nice supports.

I'm also a new player (<1 month) in and I've been able to cruise mainstory content with Aurita-Corpo-Miryam-Casiah, until Chapter 7-1 where I am at now.
